title: Outbound network probe and bounded fetch
description: Probe outbound connectivity and fetch bounded text from public HTTP(S) URLs. net.egress reports the direct and (when configured) proxy egress identity, latency and DNS reachability without exposing local interface addresses; web.fetch refuses private, loopback and reserved destinations and validates every redirect hop.

proxy.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy URL used by both executors, for example http://127.0.0.1:3128. Empty string means direct connections. Ambient HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY variables are intentionally ignored: only this value is used.

maxBytes.description: Upper bound in bytes for the JSON written to stdout. web.fetch shrinks content to fit and flags truncation; values are clamped to 1 MiB.

capabilities.title: Report outbound egress identity
capabilities.description: Query public IP-echo endpoints and report the public egress address, round-trip latency and DNS resolution status for the direct path and, when a proxy is configured, the proxied path. Local interface addresses, the proxy URL and resolved DNS addresses are never reported; a non-global address echoed by an upstream is withheld.

capabilities.title: Fetch a public URL
capabilities.description: Fetch one public http(s) URL and return status, content type, bounded text content and timing. Only ports 80/443 are allowed, URL userinfo is refused, private/loopback/link-local/CGNAT/reserved destinations are refused (including each redirect hop), and the response is capped by maxBytes. Binary bodies are reported without content bytes.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL on port 80 or 443 pointing at a public host.

maxBytes.description: Optional per-call output cap; the effective cap is the smaller of this value and the pack maxBytes config.

checks.description: offline self-test: net.egress (address classification and output fitting)
offline self-test: web.fetch (SSRF guard, parsing and output fitting)
